name: @etzhayyim/analytics-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of the analytics PUBLIC catalog (dashboards + aggregate metric datapoints + reports) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS. Mixed split: raw per-user behavioral ingestion + warehouse aggregation stays etzhayyim infra (consent-capability); only aggregate/public metrics are etzhayyim-front. No PII on-substrate. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000 + ADR-2606011400.
